parts.html: The K-06 standard model is a white, straight minimalist kitchen 4.4 linear meters long. The fronts are solid, without a pattern, and the lines are simple.
Cabinets, appliances, and the work surface take up one wall, leaving the rest of the room free for a dining table. This layout suits small apartments, studio apartments, and kitchen-living rooms.
The K-06 has two types of fronts: foil-wrapped uppers and lowers made of acrylic-faced MDF. Both rows are the same white.
Despite the modest length, there is enough storage: food and utensils fit into the cargo pull-out, and the appliances are built into the cabinets.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close mechanisms
The K-06 can be made longer or shorter to fit your wall, with the cabinets and appliances rearranged and storage systems added.
